findings.issue_text: [High/bug] pkg/expr/reader.go:194-201 — `enableSqlExpressions` is inverted and always returns false; no code path returns true, so SQL expressions are permanently broken regardless of feature flag. Should return `h.features.IsEnabledGlobally(featuremgmt.FlagSqlExpressions)`

[Medium/bug] pkg/expr/reader.go:129-132 — Error message 'sqlExpressions is not implemented' is misleading when the feature flag is simply disabled; should return a distinct 'feature flag disabled' error

[Medium/api] pkg/expr/sql/db.go:10-25 — DB methods (TablesList, RunCommands, QueryFramesInto) all return 'not implemented' but are called from sql/parser.go and sql_command.go live code paths, so every SQL expression execution fails at runtime with an unhelpful error, breaking previously working functionality

[Medium/test_gap] pkg/expr/sql/db.go — Stub DB replaces duckdb-backed implementation with no tests covering the new feature-gating logic in ReadQuery (flag on/off) or the now-failing SQL command execution path

[Low/data] go.mod / go.sum — thrift/overflow hashes removed from go.sum but re-added to go.work.sum, and dateparse/gotest.tools hashes dropped; module graph not fully reconciled (go mod tidy across workspace) may break builds of other workspace modules or external consumers

[Low/doc_defect] pkg/expr/reader.go:196 — Error string says 'not implemented' for a gating failure, conflating unimplemented with disabled, making on/off states indistinguishable to callers/monitoring

adjudication_records.issue_text: [Medium/bug] pkg/expr/reader.go:129-132 — Error message 'sqlExpressions is not implemented' is misleading when the feature flag is simply disabled; should return a distinct 'feature flag disabled' error

adjudication.rationale: In `pkg/expr/reader.go` (QueryTypeSQL), the code checks `enabled := enableSqlExpressions(h)` and if false returns `fmt.Errorf("sqlExpressions is not implemented")`. This error is emitted specifically on the feature-gating path (i.e., when SQL expressions are not enabled), so the message can be misleading because it doesn’t indicate the feature flag is disabled. This is a diagnosability/UX issue rather than a functional defect in the diff itself.

adjudication_records.issue_text: [Medium/test_gap] pkg/expr/sql/db.go — Stub DB replaces duckdb-backed implementation with no tests covering the new feature-gating logic in ReadQuery (flag on/off) or the now-failing SQL command execution path

adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces broken behavior: `pkg/expr/sql/db.go` adds a new `sql.DB` whose core methods (`TablesList`, `RunCommands`, `QueryFramesInto`) all return `errors.New("not implemented")`, and existing call sites are switched from `duck.NewInMemoryDB()` to `sql.NewInMemoryDB()` (e.g., `pkg/expr/sql_command.go` and `pkg/expr/sql/parser.go`), so SQL execution/table listing will now fail at runtime. Additionally, `enableSqlExpressions` in `pkg/expr/reader.go` always returns `false` (it negates `IsEnabledGlobally` and then returns `false` in both branches), so `ReadQuery` will always reject `QueryTypeSQL` with an error. The finding’s “no tests covering…” part can’t be verified from this diff, but the now-failing execution and feature-gating logic are verifiable defects in the changed code.

adjudication_records.issue_text: [Low/data] go.mod / go.sum — thrift/overflow hashes removed from go.sum but re-added to go.work.sum, and dateparse/gotest.tools hashes dropped; module graph not fully reconciled (go mod tidy across workspace) may break builds of other workspace modules or external consumers

adjudication.rationale: The diff does show dependency metadata churn/inconsistency: `github.com/apache/thrift v0.20.0` and `github.com/JohnCGriffin/overflow` are removed from `go.mod` and their full hashes are dropped from `go.sum`, yet both are added back into `go.work.sum`. Also `github.com/araddon/dateparse` and the `gotest.tools/v3 v3.5.1` (non-`/go.mod`) checksum are removed from `go.sum`. That supports the finding’s claim that the workspace/module sums weren’t reconciled uniformly (e.g., root module tidy vs workspace sums). However, the claim that this "may break builds" is speculative from the diff alone (Go can often regenerate missing sums), so it’s more of a housekeeping/consistency issue than a verifiable build break.

adjudication_records.issue_text: [Low/doc_defect] pkg/expr/reader.go:196 — Error string says 'not implemented' for a gating failure, conflating unimplemented with disabled, making on/off states indistinguishable to callers/monitoring

adjudication.rationale: In pkg/expr/reader.go, the new SQL branch gates execution via enableSqlExpressions(h) and on failure returns fmt.Errorf("sqlExpressions is not implemented"). That error is emitted for a feature-flag gating failure (disabled), not necessarily for missing implementation, so it conflates “disabled” with “unimplemented” and makes on/off states indistinguishable to callers/monitoring as the finding claims.
